title: Behavioural biometrics and keystroke dynamics guides · KeyBio
description: Clear guides to behavioural biometrics and keystroke dynamics: what they are, what is measured, how the algorithms work, how accurate they are and what the GDPR says.
heading: Guides to keystroke biometrics
lead: What behavioural biometrics is, how a person can be recognised by the way they type and what lies behind the algorithms, explained without jargon and with a demo to try it.
ctaTitle: Try it with your own typing
ctaText: The KeyBio demo builds your typing fingerprint from two sentences and then tries to recognise you. It runs entirely in your browser: your keystrokes are never sent anywhere.
